summary: Implements FGSC-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/FAST_GREEN_SELF_CERTIFICATION_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT.md, frozen by 2S, independently verified by 2S.1 with 0 blocking findings) inside the two production modules the contract itself names as candidate surfaces. src/pcae/core/fast_green_attribution.py gained FinalizationPathClass, classify_finalization_path() (contract Section 4 path classification, fail-closed on unknown paths, content-sensitivity restriction via data-format extension + Git file-mode check for symlink/gitlink/executable), diff_authority_issues() (ancestry via git merge-base --is-ancestor, merge-commit rejection via git rev-list --min-parents=2, per-path classification of both old_path and new_path from a git diff --raw -z -M -C rename/copy-aware parse), and check_finalization_delta() (contract Section 14 conditions 3-4) -- no existing function modified; validate_structured_fast_green()'s own strict-equality freshness check remains byte-for-byte unchanged, exactly as the contract requires (Section 14: 'not for the function's own unit behavior'). src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py's validate_derived_correctness() gained a precise carve-out: when validate_structured_fast_green() reports staleness as its SOLE issue, the lifecycle-freshness replacement condition is checked (checkpoint ancestry + diff authority + a new run_stage_b_focused_checks() implementing contract Section 8's focused-check set in-process against pcae.core.check/status/tasks) instead of blocking outright; any other structured-evidence defect (baseline mismatch, attribution mismatch, etc.) still blocks unconditionally, byte-identical to before this phase. pcae push check was deliberately excluded from Stage B -- duplicating it inside phase_reports.py would violate this repository's own core->commands architecture-layering policy (caught live by pcae check itself during implementation, not merely asserted: an initial draft imported pcae.commands.push from core and pcae check flagged 'core -> commands is not allowed by policy'; fixed by removing that import and documenting the rationale in code). report.metadata gained three optional, backward-compatible fields (fgsc_verification_checkpoint_commit, fgsc_final_phase_head, fgsc_lifecycle_state) per contract Section 18, set only once all five Section 14 conditions hold. This phase's own finalization honestly uses the pre-existing scalar+deselection convention, not the structured lifecycle it introduces -- the same self-referential limitation Phase 149O.20L.7O.2R's real history already established, disclosed plainly rather than disguised. Controlled A/B Fast Green comparison (git stash -u, identical pytest -m fast_green -n auto both sides): baseline (123a6750) 336 failed/8690 passed/5 skipped/9 errors; candidate 352 failed/8674 passed/5 skipped/9 errors; exactly 16 new failures, zero newly-fixed-then-hidden; all 16 confirmed to be pre-existing 'no dirty src/pcae working tree' frozen-source-scope guard tests from unrelated already-completed phases that trip on any legitimate src/pcae/** change by construction, not a functional regression. Deselected: 8674 passed, 336 failed (set-equal to baseline), 5 skipped, 9 errors (identical to baseline). 39 new focused/adversarial tests all pass (path classification, diff authority, ancestry/merge/rename edge cases, end-to-end lifecycle carve-out through validate_derived_correctness, crash/resume reconstruction from Git+artifact alone, Stage B runner); the existing 18-test 2R attribution suite and 343-test phase-report/finalization-transaction suite both pass unmodified. No contract text amended; N1/N2/N3 not opportunistically repaired, carried forward exactly. Phase 149O.20L.7O.2P confirmed untouched.
